sourceBehavior: Sessions remain raw SI; capacityWh = total_energy_added_wh / ((end_soc_pct - start_soc_pct) / 100).
Completion is required explicitly; no duration-to-completion synthesis.
Unknown/missing SoC and energy get separate exclusion categories; zero energy and nonpositive gain are invalid, not missing.
SoC=0 is allowed when a valid positive completed gain exists; negative annual change and negative innovations remain signed.
10,000–200,000 Wh plausible bounds, 1 pp SoC sigma, 0.015 relative meter sigma and 30 Wh/sqrt(day) process default are model assumptions.
Fit gates are 12 observations, 180 elapsed days, 6 local active months; annualization uses 365.25 days, not a causal forecast.
History cap=1000, timeline cap=200, directory cap=25, monthly display cap=24. Summary uses every included row within the analysis cap.
No separate measured full-pack capacity source, nominal specification endpoint or laboratory measurement is consumed.
SoC window and process-noise changes are local model assumptions, not charging-dose commands or persistent settings.

findings.rule: MDC-026/MDC-040 unknown is not measured zero; accessible chart alternative must use the same trust gate as the plot
findings.mechanism: Empty sessions produce fixed SoC bins, sensitivity thresholds and innovation bins with zero counts. These rows are passed unconditionally as ChartContainer data. PackCapacitySectionBody gates only the plot. The separately rendered figcaption table depends on data.length/dataColumns, not source resolution/loading/fatal/no-vehicle state.
findings.reasonedRepro: Load without a selected vehicle, while initial history is pending, or after initial failure with no retained history. The visual body explains unavailable evidence, but the accessible/forced-colors table still enumerates zero Samples/Included sessions for an unestablished source. This uses normal supported source states, not a malformed payload.
findings.fix: Gate chart fallback data/count-bearing arrays on resolved usable history or extend existing ChartContainer source-state handling without removing the frame or known-empty resolved bins. Keep retained refresh data available and explain unresolved state in the accessible alternative.
findings.owner: page/feature chart adapters; shared chart owner only if a shared trust API change is required
findings.runtimeEvidence: NOTRUN; deterministic JSX/dataflow finding, not an observed screen-reader/native result

findings.rule: MDC-045 dimensional labeling; process variance is a rate assumption, not energy
findings.mechanism: X data is processNoiseWhPerSqrtDay. CSV/fallback heading and control correctly describe Wh / square-root day, but XAxis unit=' Wh' labels the same values as plain energy.
findings.reasonedRepro: Any qualified result displays assumption 30 as 30 Wh on the process-sensitivity axis although the analyzer squares a 30 Wh/sqrt(day) noise rate and multiplies by elapsed days.
findings.fix: Use a consistent localized Wh/sqrt(day) assumption label for the X axis and tooltip/accessible output. Do not convert the model noise operand as if it were a measured pack-energy display.

findings.rule: MDC-026 unknown numeric fact is not zero
findings.mechanism: No qualified observation leaves daysSinceLastObservation=null. buildSupport changes its displayed ingredient value to 0, while score remains no-support zero. EvidenceSupport requirement=none renders the recency sublabel as 0/30, unlike Coverage which correctly withholds recency.
findings.reasonedRepro: A successful empty charging-history response, or valid returned sessions all excluded, has no latest observation. Support panel nevertheless exposes a zero-day recency ingredient.
findings.fix: Keep the ingredient's unknown recency value nullable and render an explicit unknown marker/reason while retaining score=0 for the no-support weighting.
findings.owner: battery domain helper plus EvidenceSupport presentation

findings.rule: MDC-033 unknown denominator/share differs from known count zero
findings.mechanism: When returnedRows=0, category-share formatting and the excluded-share metric substitute zero for 0/0. Coverage correctly returns qualifiedShare=null for the same denominator.
findings.reasonedRepro: Successful GET charging returns []. Accounting shows legitimate zero returned/included/excluded counts, but all category Returned share cells and Excluded share present 0% despite no defined population share.
findings.fix: Use nullable shares for returnedRows=0 and the existing em-dash/missing-reason formatting; preserve true zero counts and zero shares when the denominator is positive.

findings.rule: MDC-026 retained refresh failures need last-success context and individual retry
findings.mechanism: Charging DataState carries updatedAt/ageMs. The page adapter forwards refreshError and retry but no last-success identity. SourceNotice exits when refreshError exists. QueryStatus warns and retries but gives no loaded-at time; BatteryEvidenceBrief alltime period has no snapshot freshness.
findings.reasonedRepro: Retained valid history followed by a failed refresh preserves its analytics and shows a warning, but the user cannot determine when that displayed history last loaded. The frozen observation-recency clock is not a substitute for source last-success time.
findings.fix: Forward actual source updatedAt/ageMs through the existing source-warning/summary metadata path and localize the last-success context while preserving content and the individual retry.
findings.owner: page/feature trust adapter/status; existing feedback owner only if an API extension is necessary

findings.rule: MDC-026/MDC-060 capped historical views must disclose the actual omitted scope
findings.mechanism: The monthly view keeps only latest maxTrendMonths=24 and records omittedTrendMonths. The mounted coverage disclosure names omitted timeline/directory rows only. Neither monthly view nor another mounted part consumes omittedTrendMonths.
findings.reasonedRepro: Normal valid completed history spanning more than 24 calendar months yields a truncated monthly view, including omitted earlier zero/measurement months, without stating its 24-month display cap. Summaries still use older included observations.
findings.fix: Expose returned/displayed/omitted month counts beside the monthly chart using existing chart sampling/source metadata or localized disclosure; do not change the history/summary calculation.

findings.rule: MDC-040/MDC-045 accessible alternatives must retain displayed measurement units
findings.mechanism: Fit plot rows contain converted display energy. The Y axis has energyUnit, but its accessible table columns say only Filtered estimate and Descriptive linear fit; no unit metadata is passed to EmbeddedChart.
findings.reasonedRepro: With a valid fit, the screen-reader/forced-colors alternative reports a numeric value such as 75 without identifying kWh, while the model's canonical Wh quantity would be 75000. This is missing dimensional context, not evidence that conversion itself is incorrect.
findings.fix: Include energyUnit in the accessible column labels or existing chart unit metadata, consistently with the other capacity charts.
